discoverySummary.deloitteOutcome: Deloitte: no new verified fresher-eligible role. Two promising Deloitte USI associate-analyst requisitions returned inconclusive employer-side 406 responses, so they were held as REVIEW rather than called Live or Expired.
discoverySummary.shortfall: Priority is complete at 6 technical full-time, 2 non-technical full-time and 2 internship/training roles. Backup remains empty: 10 backup slots are unfilled rather than using previously reviewed, published, experienced, blocked or source-incomplete jobs.

ranking.policy: Deloitte first; then approved 87 employers; then exact-source, zero-experience-eligible fallback employers. One normalized employer across the saved batch.
ranking.note: Automated source verdicts are separate from owner review. All reviewedStatus fields remain unreviewed; no publication or Telegram action is authorized.
